entry.title: Free Fabric Textures
entry.summary: Free Fabric Textures gives you 10 high-resolution overlays scanned directly from real tees—the soft, broken-in kind you’d find in a vintage band’s merch box. You’ll get authentic jersey knit textures and subtle textile grain that makes apparel graphics look and feel like real clothing. The collection ranges from deep blacks and navy blues to soft heather grays and off-whites, with everything from smooth jersey fabric to tighter ribbed textures. Drop one over your T-shirt design, merch mockup, or streetwear graphic, choose a blend mode, and instantly add a realistic fabric look. These 300 DPI JPEGs work in any image editor and stay sharp at full size. Download them free and start creating.

entry.title: Sistema Gráfico | Morfología II | UADE
entry.summary:
[ESP] Creé un sistema gráfico basado en los patrones visuales que encontré durante un relevamiento fotográfico. Para darle forma al concepto, usé Adobe Photoshop para diseñar un collage que reúne los momentos más interesantes y los elementos más potentes que rescaté del análisis fotográfico.
